title: Ordered projection adjunctions with finite normalizations
statement: For distinct primes ell,p, k of characteristic p, finite E/Q_ell, common coefficient operations b,o, coordinates q,z, preservation h, coherent calculus cal and Tate family w, fix foundations a [lem-sp-coordinate-foundations]. For each ordered affine projection p_d and every coefficient-independent compactification c, there is a restricted adjunction F_(p_d,c) left adjoint to p_d^*(-)(d)[2d] [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories]. Its affine-line Hom map is the fixed projective Hom map followed by the open adjunction and a.affine. At d=0 its Hom map is the identity adjunction transported by the compact-support identity and a.zero. At every successor its counit is the composite counit transported by the calculus composition and a.step. Evaluation supplies an adjunction on all finite constructible finite-Tor objects, with both transpose, unit and counit equations, left comparison supportEvaluation and right comparison projectionEvaluation. No etale chart adjunction is asserted.

source.place: Local pairs and Levels; explicit categorical details of the original coordinate argument

proof.text:
Restrict the projective-line Hom equivalence to the admissible domains in a.
Compose it with extension-by-zero/inverse-image adjunction and the normalized affine
right comparison. Transport compact support by its specified realization and
compactification comparison. This is the displayed affine Hom formula. Start the
ordered induction at the identity adjunction, transported through a.zero and the
compact-support identity comparison. At the successor, compose the preceding
projection pair with the affine-line pair at the coordinate base. Transport the
left composite by cal.composition.composition and the right by a.step. The counit
formula for composition is precisely CompositeEquation, including the inverse
left comparison. Compactification refinement transports the construction to every
specified compactification and coherence makes the formula independent of the
intermediate choices. Repeat these constructions on all finite constructible
finite-Tor objects, using the finite projective/open formulas, not only objects
which lift to towers. Evaluate the actual compositions: the fixed support and
right evaluation comparisons commute with the Hom equivalences. This proves both
transpose formulas and, by transposing identities, unit and counit compatibility.
No faithfulness of derived evaluation is used.
